1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study).
2．Applicants for master's program should be under 30 by September 1st, 2027.
3．Academic Requirement: By September 1st, 2027, applicants for master's program must hold a bachelor's degree.

4．Learning Ability: Applicants should have good learning ability and academic performance. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. For CSC scholarship applicants, the requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 80% and above.
Applicants may provide other evidence of academic ability, such as the GRE and GMAT scores.
Applicants should have Chinese or English language proficiency that meets the requirement.
6．Nationality Requirements: The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.

For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold the passports or citizenship certificates of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years.
Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents:
1) The certificate proving that the applicant obtained the foreign nationality at birth;
2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality.
GPA 80/100有硕士导师接收函优先录取
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for master applicants.
Applicants must complete the online application and psychological evaluation in the official NPU application portal.

applicationMaterials.en:
1. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport.
The passport should be valid until December 31, 2027 at least. Applicants currently residing in Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page.
If the applicant does not have a passport at the time for application, the national ID can be used instead. However the passport is one of the mandatory application documents. Applicants should apply for it and provide to Admissions Office as soon as possible.

2. A copy of undergraduate diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the undergraduate program in China.
Graduating students can provide pre-graduation certificate, indicating the expected time for graduation. The original/notarized diploma undergraduate diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate period.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors ( associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Master Degree program (based on given template. Please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, the language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).

8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor (Please check the template by clicking here).
The below schools require that the Master Program Applicants must have the acceptance letter from supervisors to complete the application:
School of Aeronautics
School of Astronautics
School of Materials Science and Engineering
School of Mechanical Engineering
School of Electronics and Information
School of Automation
School of Physical Science and Technology
School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
School of Life Science and Technology
School of Foreign Studies
School of Civil Aviation
School of Flexible Electronics
For the applicants who apply for master majors in other schools, acceptance letter is not a must and will be a bonus point.
9. Officially recognized awards, scientific research achievements (if any).

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.
11. Bank statement (with a closing balance no less than 5000USD).
12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to：https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm..
2)  Some schools have specific requirements on GPA or students’ language or Master program acceptance letter from professors:
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for master applicants.
School of Public Policy and Administration requires HSK level 6 (180 or above) for Chinese medium major applicants.
3)  All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations are required if materials are in other languages.

4)  All academic documents submitted by an applicant electronically are checked to ensure they are legitimate before an offer is confirmed. Once students arrive at NPU, we will re-examine all the original and hard-copy documents.

5) Please do not renew your passport after application submission without special reasons. Otherwise, the information on the Visa Application Form (JW202 and JW201) will be inconsistent and it would affect your visa application.

On-site registration originals and checks: Original Documents1. Passport 2. Bachelor degree diploma3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate period4. Physical Examination Form for Foreigners (Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray Report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. Materials in other languages must be accompanied by a notarized English or Chinese translation.2. If your undergraduate studies were completed in China, the Bachelor graduation certificate must be provided.3. Applicants who fail to provide the above materials, or whose original documents are inconsistent with the scanned copies submitted during the application, will have their admission qualification canceled.4. Applicants whose physical examination records are inconsistent with their actual health status will have their admission qualification canceled.5. For the rest of the documents required for registration, the International College will issue a registration guideline with all relevant information around July.

2. A copy of undergraduate diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the undergraduate program in China.
Graduating students can provide pre-graduation certificate, indicating the expected time for graduation. The original/notarized diploma undergraduate diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate period.

5. Study plan for Master Degree program (based on given template. Please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, the language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).

8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor (Please check the template by clicking here).

School of Aeronautics
School of Astronautics
School of Materials Science and Engineering
School of Mechanical Engineering
School of Electronics and Information
School of Automation
School of Physical Science and Technology
School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
School of Life Science and Technology
School of Foreign Studies
School of Civil Aviation
School of Flexible Electronics

Physical Examination Form for Foreigners (Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray Report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. eligibility.en: Admission to NPU is based on academic merit and open competition. Before application, please ensure that you satisfy the admission requirements.
Depending on the competitiveness of each applicant cohort, admission criteria may vary from year to year.
1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study).
2．Applicants for doctoral program should be under 35 by September 1st, 2027.
3．Academic Requirement: By September 1st, 2027, applicants for doctoral program must hold a master's degree.

4．Learning Ability: Applicants should have good learning ability and academic performance. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. For CSC scholarship applicants, the requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 80% and above.
Applicants may provide other evidence of academic ability, such as the GRE and GMAT scores.
Applicants should have Chinese or English language proficiency that meets the requirement.
6．Nationality Requirements: The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.

For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold the passports or citizenship certificates of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years.
Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents:
1) The certificate proving that the applicant obtained the foreign nationality at birth;
2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality.
Applicants must complete the online application and psychological evaluation in the official NPU application portal.

applicationMaterials.en:
1. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport.
The passport should be valid until December 31, 2027 at least. Applicants currently residing in Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page.
If the applicant does not have the passport at the time for application, the national ID can be used instead. However, the passport is one of the mandatory application documents. Applicants should apply for it and provide to Admissions Office as soon as possible.

2. A copy of both undergraduate and master diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the previous degrees in China.
Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation certificate indicating the expected graduation time. The original/notarized diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during both undergraduate and master periods.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors (associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Doctoral Degree program (Based on given template, please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).
8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor: For PhD programs applicants, the acceptance letter is a mandatory document (Please check the template by clicking here).

Scientific research achievements are a must for PhD applicants, including research publications, patents and/or scientific research awards.

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.
11. Bank statement (with a closing balance no less than 5000USD).
12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm.
2) Some schools have specific requirements on GPA:
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for PhD applicants.
3) All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations is required if materials are in other languages.

4) All academic documents submitted by an applicant electronically are checked to ensure they are legitimate before an offer is confirmed. Once students arrive at NPU, we will re-examine all the original and hard-copy documents.

5) Please do not renew your passport after application submission without special reasons. Otherwise, the information on the Visa Application Form (JW202 and JW201) will be inconsistent and it would affect your visa application.

On-site registration originals and checks: Original Documents1. Passport 2. Bachelor and Master’s degree diplomas3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate and Masters’s study period4. Physical Examination Form for Foreigners ( Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. Materials in other languages must be accompanied by a notarized English or Chinese translation.2. If your any stage of academic studies were completed in China, the graduation certificate must be provided.3. Applicants who fail to provide the above materials, or whose original documents are inconsistent with the scanned copies submitted during the application, will have their admission qualification canceled.4. Applicants whose physical examination records are inconsistent with their actual health status will have their admission qualification canceled.5. For the rest of the documents required for registration, the International College will issue a registration guideline with all relevant information around July.

eligibility.en: Admission to NPU is based on academic merit and open competition. Before application, please ensure that you satisfy the admission requirements.
Depending on the competitiveness of each applicant cohort, admission criteria may vary from year to year.
1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study).
2．Applicants for doctoral program should be under 35 by September 1st, 2027.
3．Academic Requirement: By September 1st, 2027, applicants for doctoral program must hold a master's degree.

4．Learning Ability: Applicants should have good learning ability and academic performance. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. For CSC scholarship applicants, the requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 80% and above.
Applicants may provide other evidence of academic ability, such as the GRE and GMAT scores.
Applicants should have Chinese or English language proficiency that meets the requirement.
6．Nationality Requirements: The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.

For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold the passports or citizenship certificates of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years.
Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents:
1) The certificate proving that the applicant obtained the foreign nationality at birth;
2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality.
Applicants must complete the online application and psychological evaluation in the official NPU application portal.

applicationMaterials.en:
1. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport.
The passport should be valid until December 31, 2027 at least. Applicants currently residing in Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page.
If the applicant does not have the passport at the time for application, the national ID can be used instead. However, the passport is one of the mandatory application documents. Applicants should apply for it and provide to Admissions Office as soon as possible.

2. A copy of both undergraduate and master diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the previous degrees in China.
Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation certificate indicating the expected graduation time. The original/notarized diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during both undergraduate and master periods.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors (associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Doctoral Degree program (Based on given template, please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).
8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor: For PhD programs applicants, the acceptance letter is a mandatory document (Please check the template by clicking here).

9. Officially recognized awards, scientific research achievements
Scientific research achievements are a must for PhD applicants, including research publications, patents and/or scientific research awards.

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.
11. Bank statement (with a closing balance no less than 5000USD).
12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm.
2) Some schools have specific requirements on GPA:
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for PhD applicants.
3) All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations is required if materials are in other languages.

4) All academic documents submitted by an applicant electronically are checked to ensure they are legitimate before an offer is confirmed. Once students arrive at NPU, we will re-examine all the original and hard-copy documents.

5) Please do not renew your passport after application submission without special reasons. Otherwise, the information on the Visa Application Form (JW202 and JW201) will be inconsistent and it would affect your visa application.

On-site registration originals and checks: Original Documents1. Passport 2. Bachelor and Master’s degree diplomas3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate and Masters’s study period4. Physical Examination Form for Foreigners ( Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. Materials in other languages must be accompanied by a notarized English or Chinese translation.2. If your any stage of academic studies were completed in China, the graduation certificate must be provided.3. Applicants who fail to provide the above materials, or whose original documents are inconsistent with the scanned copies submitted during the application, will have their admission qualification canceled.4. Applicants whose physical examination records are inconsistent with their actual health status will have their admission qualification canceled.5. For the rest of the documents required for registration, the International College will issue a registration guideline with all relevant information around July.

applicationMaterials.en:

2. A copy of both undergraduate and master diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the previous degrees in China.
Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation certificate indicating the expected graduation time. The original/notarized diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during both undergraduate and master periods.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors (associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Doctoral Degree program (Based on given template, please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.

12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm.

Physical Examination Form for Foreigners ( Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. eligibility.en: Admission to NPU is based on academic merit and open competition. Before application, please ensure that you satisfy the admission requirements.
Depending on the competitiveness of each applicant cohort, admission criteria may vary from year to year.
1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study).
2．Applicants for doctoral program should be under 35 by September 1st, 2027.
3．Academic Requirement: By September 1st, 2027, applicants for doctoral program must hold a master's degree.

4．Learning Ability: Applicants should have good learning ability and academic performance. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. For CSC scholarship applicants, the requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 80% and above.
Applicants may provide other evidence of academic ability, such as the GRE and GMAT scores.
Applicants should have Chinese or English language proficiency that meets the requirement.
6．Nationality Requirements: The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.

For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold the passports or citizenship certificates of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years.
Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents:
1) The certificate proving that the applicant obtained the foreign nationality at birth;
2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality.
Applicants must complete the online application and psychological evaluation in the official NPU application portal.

applicationMaterials.en:
1. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport.
The passport should be valid until December 31, 2027 at least. Applicants currently residing in Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page.
If the applicant does not have the passport at the time for application, the national ID can be used instead. However, the passport is one of the mandatory application documents. Applicants should apply for it and provide to Admissions Office as soon as possible.

2. A copy of both undergraduate and master diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the previous degrees in China.
Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation certificate indicating the expected graduation time. The original/notarized diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during both undergraduate and master periods.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors (associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Doctoral Degree program (Based on given template, please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).
8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor: For PhD programs applicants, the acceptance letter is a mandatory document (Please check the template by clicking here).

9. Officially recognized awards, scientific research achievements
Scientific research achievements are a must for PhD applicants, including research publications, patents and/or scientific research awards.

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.
11. Bank statement (with a closing balance no less than 5000USD).
12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm.
2) Some schools have specific requirements on GPA:
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for PhD applicants.
3) All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations is required if materials are in other languages.

4) All academic documents submitted by an applicant electronically are checked to ensure they are legitimate before an offer is confirmed. Once students arrive at NPU, we will re-examine all the original and hard-copy documents.

5) Please do not renew your passport after application submission without special reasons. Otherwise, the information on the Visa Application Form (JW202 and JW201) will be inconsistent and it would affect your visa application.

1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study).
2．Applicants for doctoral program should be under 35 by September 1st, 2027.
3．Academic Requirement: By September 1st, 2027, applicants for doctoral program must hold a master's degree.

4．Learning Ability: Applicants should have good learning ability and academic performance. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. For CSC scholarship applicants, the requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 80% and above.
Applicants may provide other evidence of academic ability, such as the GRE and GMAT scores.
Applicants should have Chinese or English language proficiency that meets the requirement.
6．Nationality Requirements: The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.

For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold the passports or citizenship certificates of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years.
Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents:
1) The certificate proving that the applicant obtained the foreign nationality at birth;
2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality.
Applicants must complete the online application and psychological evaluation in the official NPU application portal.

applicationMaterials.en:
1. A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport.
The passport should be valid until December 31, 2027 at least. Applicants currently residing in Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page.
If the applicant does not have the passport at the time for application, the national ID can be used instead. However, the passport is one of the mandatory application documents. Applicants should apply for it and provide to Admissions Office as soon as possible.

2. A copy of both undergraduate and master diploma.
Both degree and graduation certificate are asked to provide for applicants who finish the previous degrees in China.
Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation certificate indicating the expected graduation time. The original/notarized diploma must be provided for registration after admission.
3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during both undergraduate and master periods.
4. Recommendation letters from two professors (associate professor or level above).
5. Study plan for Doctoral Degree program (Based on given template, please check the template by clicking here).

6. Chinese (HSK)/English language certificate (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE).
Under these circumstances, language certificate is not needed:
Applicants who are Chinese native speakers and applying for Chinese medium majors.
Applicants who are English native speakers and applying for English medium majors.
7. Non-criminal record (valid for six months).
8. Acceptance letter from a supervisor: For PhD programs applicants, the acceptance letter is a mandatory document (Please check the template by clicking here).

9. Officially recognized awards, scientific research achievements
Scientific research achievements are a must for PhD applicants, including research publications, patents and/or scientific research awards.

10. Copy of "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months), which shall be deemed invalid if it is incomplete, lacks the applicant’s photograph, has no cross-seal on the photograph, or is not signed and sealed by the examining physician and hospital.
11. Bank statement (with a closing balance no less than 5000USD).
12. Other supplementary materials required.
13. Students applying for architecture or design majors shall provide one’s own art/design portfolio.
1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to https://studyat.nwpu.edu.cn/info/1192/6021.htm.
2) Some schools have specific requirements on GPA:
School of Management requires GPA of 80% and above for PhD applicants.
3) All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations is required if materials are in other languages.

4) All academic documents submitted by an applicant electronically are checked to ensure they are legitimate before an offer is confirmed. Once students arrive at NPU, we will re-examine all the original and hard-copy documents.

5) Please do not renew your passport after application submission without special reasons. Otherwise, the information on the Visa Application Form (JW202 and JW201) will be inconsistent and it would affect your visa application.

On-site registration originals and checks: Original Documents1. Passport 2. Bachelor and Master’s degree diplomas3. Transcripts for each semester/academic year during undergraduate and Masters’s study period4. Physical Examination Form for Foreigners ( Includes Blood Test Report and X-Ray report)Notes：1.  All the aforementioned materials must be in English or Chinese. Materials in other languages must be accompanied by a notarized English or Chinese translation.2. If your any stage of academic studies were completed in China, the graduation certificate must be provided.3. Applicants who fail to provide the above materials, or whose original documents are inconsistent with the scanned copies submitted during the application, will have their admission qualification canceled.4. Applicants whose physical examination records are inconsistent with their actual health status will have their admission qualification canceled.5. For the rest of the documents required for registration, the International College will issue a registration guideline with all relevant information around July.

languageRequirements.minimum: Level 5; total 180 or above; each subscore at least 60. Malaysian independent Chinese high school UEC may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课；入学HSK5级180分以上、单项不低于60分。CSCA科目：文科中文、数学；测试语种须选中文。

eligibility.zh: 申请者须高中毕业以上学历、身体健康、非中国籍，年龄在18周岁以上且不超过30周岁；2027年未满足18周岁的申请不予接收。
须符合教育部教外函（2020）12号文件；涉及中国血统/转国籍者，须满足国籍取得、父母永久居留、近四年实际境外居住等适用要求，详情以官方指南为准。
申请人可填两个志愿并选择是否服从调剂，学院可能安排笔试/面试；材料真实准确，未通过入学资格复核取消资格。

applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照；有效期不早于2028年3月1日，在中国大陆境内申请者提交所有签证/居留许可页扫描件。
三年全日制高中毕业证书或预毕业证明；马来西亚SPM、两年制高中另需一年大学预科证书。
高中三年全部课程成绩单；马来西亚SPM、两年制高中另需一年大学预科成绩单或STPM、A-level。
HSK成绩证书；马来西亚华文独立中学UEC可替代HSK，截图须在报到时补正式证书。
CSCA测试成绩单，须于5月15日前提交；专业科目要求见本项目说明。
高中老师撰写的1–2封中文或英文推荐信。
本科学习计划，包含个人介绍、学习经历和申请理由。
非中文或英文的高中毕业证和成绩单须提供中文或英文官方翻译公证件。
根据个人情况提交华裔/转国籍身份证明、诚信承诺书和在华监护确认书。

Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分及以上（机构代码C310）或IELTS Academic6.0及以上；前置学历英文授课可提交学校授课语言证明，以英语作为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，也接受学校认定的其他同等英语水平证明。

eligibility.zh: 身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民；外籍华人等须按申请系统要求提交国籍预审文件并在入学时携带纸件，未通过预审或认定者失去资格。
截止2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过45周岁；应届本科毕业生或具有大学本科以上学历。
英文授课国际硕士项目原则上开班人数5人及以上。

applicationMaterials.zh: 护照首页扫描件（普通护照，有效期至2027年10月31日后）。
出生证明。
父母有效身份证件。
学历证书及完整成绩单；应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明，报到查验原件。
国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证机构公证；报到时须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。
语言水平证明。
境外人员体格检查记录表和胸部X光片、心电图、化验室原始报告扫描件；照片加盖医院章并覆盖下沿，体检有效期6个月。
国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。
有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。
中英文以外的材料须附经公证的中文或英文翻译件。
材料提交后不可修改；无需常规邮寄纸件，但学校保留要求邮寄或指定认证的权利，材料不退还。
两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，以中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务和联系方式，亲笔签名或加盖单位章。
不少于1000字的英文学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划、职业规划；经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。
个人简历。
接收意向函可选；须导师签字和学院盖章，取得者优先录取。

faculty.zh: 海洋与海岸带发展研究院

languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分及以上（机构代码C310）或IELTS Academic6.0及以上；前置学历英文授课可提交学校授课语言证明，以英语作为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，也接受学校认定的其他同等英语水平证明。

eligibility.zh: 身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民；外籍华人等须按申请系统要求提交国籍预审文件并在入学时携带纸件，未通过预审或认定者失去资格。
截止2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过45周岁；应届本科毕业生或具有大学本科以上学历。
英文授课国际硕士项目原则上开班人数5人及以上。

applicationMaterials.zh: 护照首页扫描件（普通护照，有效期至2027年10月31日后）。
出生证明。
父母有效身份证件。
学历证书及完整成绩单；应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明，报到查验原件。
国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证机构公证；报到时须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。
语言水平证明。
境外人员体格检查记录表和胸部X光片、心电图、化验室原始报告扫描件；照片加盖医院章并覆盖下沿，体检有效期6个月。
国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。
有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。
中英文以外的材料须附经公证的中文或英文翻译件。
材料提交后不可修改；无需常规邮寄纸件，但学校保留要求邮寄或指定认证的权利，材料不退还。

Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

faculty.en: The Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics

languagePolicy.en: English-medium: TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS Academic 6.0 or above. A prior-degree English-medium certificate may be submitted; applicants from countries with English as an official language are exempt from English evidence. XMU-recognized equivalent English evidence is accepted.
languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分以上或IELTS Academic6.0分以上；可提供前置学历英文授课证明，英语为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，接受厦门大学认定的其他同等证明。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: iBT 80 or above; XMU institution code C310.
Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

faculty.en: Institute for Financial and Accounting Studies
faculty.zh: 财务管理与会计研究院

languagePolicy.en: English-medium: TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS Academic 6.0 or above. A prior-degree English-medium certificate may be submitted; applicants from countries with English as an official language are exempt from English evidence. XMU-recognized equivalent English evidence is accepted.
languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分以上或IELTS Academic6.0分以上；可提供前置学历英文授课证明，英语为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，接受厦门大学认定的其他同等证明。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: iBT 80 or above; XMU institution code C310.
Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

faculty.en: College of Ocean and Earth Sciences

languagePolicy.en: English-medium: TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS Academic 6.0 or above. A prior-degree English-medium certificate may be submitted; applicants from countries with English as an official language are exempt from English evidence. XMU-recognized equivalent English evidence is accepted.
languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分以上或IELTS Academic6.0分以上；可提供前置学历英文授课证明，英语为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，接受厦门大学认定的其他同等证明。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: iBT 80 or above; XMU institution code C310.
Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

faculty.en: School of Electronic Science and Engineering

languagePolicy.en: English-medium: TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS Academic 6.0 or above. A prior-degree English-medium certificate may be submitted; applicants from countries with English as an official language are exempt from English evidence. XMU-recognized equivalent English evidence is accepted.
languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分以上或IELTS Academic6.0分以上；可提供前置学历英文授课证明，英语为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，接受厦门大学认定的其他同等证明。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 words covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in English.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用英文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: iBT 80 or above; XMU institution code C310.
Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: iBT 80 or above; XMU institution code C310.
Academic 6.0 or above, or prior English medium certificate / XMU-recognized equivalent; official-English-language-country applicants exempt.

languagePolicy.en: English-medium: TOEFL iBT 80 or above or IELTS Academic 6.0 or above. A prior-degree English-medium certificate may be submitted; applicants from countries with English as an official language are exempt from English evidence. XMU-recognized equivalent English evidence is accepted.
languagePolicy.zh: 英文授课：TOEFL iBT80分以上或IELTS Academic6.0分以上；可提供前置学历英文授课证明，英语为官方语言国家的申请者免交英语证明，接受厦门大学认定的其他同等证明。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
