eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

faculty.en: College of Physical Science and Technology

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

name.zh: 微电子学与固体电子学

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level5 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 5 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK5级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
eligibility.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
eligibility.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
eligibility.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
eligibility.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
eligibility.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
eligibility.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
eligibility.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
eligibility.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
eligibility.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
eligibility.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

applicationMaterials.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
applicationMaterials.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
applicationMaterials.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
eligibility.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
applicationMaterials.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
applicationMaterials.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.

applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
applicationMaterials.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
applicationMaterials.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
applicationMaterials.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
applicationMaterials.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
applicationMaterials.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
applicationMaterials.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
applicationMaterials.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
applicationMaterials.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
applicationMaterials.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
applicationMaterials.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

name.en: Data Science in Health and Intellectual Medicine
name.zh: 健康大数据与智能医学

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
eligibility.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
eligibility.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
eligibility.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
eligibility.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
eligibility.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
eligibility.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
eligibility.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
eligibility.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
eligibility.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
eligibility.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

applicationMaterials.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
applicationMaterials.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
applicationMaterials.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
applicationMaterials.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner physical-examination form plus original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory-report scans. Attach the applicant’s photo with a hospital stamp overlapping its lower edge; examination validity is 6 months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 境外人员体格检查记录表、胸部X光片、心电图及特定项目化验室原始报告扫描件；本人照片须医院盖章覆盖照片下沿，体检有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: International-student financial-guarantee form and supporting guarantee-document scans; scholarship applicants must also submit them.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国际学生经济担保书及其他担保材料扫描件，奖学金申请者也须提交。

applicationMaterials.en: A valid criminal-record clearance certificate, normally issued within 6 months before application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 有效无犯罪记录证明，通常须在提交申请之日前6个月以内。

applicationMaterials.en: Optional supplementary evidence includes publications, competition awards, research activities, conferences and skills certificates. Arts applicants must submit personal work such as audio/video or paintings in Other Supporting Materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 可选补充材料包括论文发表、竞赛获奖、科研活动、学术会议及技能资格证明；艺术类申请者须提交个人作品（音像、绘画等），上传“其他辅助材料”。

applicationMaterials.en: Application information and materials cannot be changed after submission. Documents in other languages require the originals and notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提交后不可修改申请信息或材料；非中英文材料须同时提交原件及经公证的中文或英文翻译。

applicationMaterials.en: Routine mailing of original documents is unnecessary, but XMU may request originals or specified authentication; submitted materials are not returned.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无需常规邮寄原件，但学校可要求邮寄或指定方式认证；材料不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: School of Medicine professional doctorate applicants (programme codes beginning with 105) must submit a Medical Practitioner Qualification Certificate and a Certificate of Completion of Standardized Residency Training to the School of Medicine.
applicationMaterials.zh: 医学院专业型博士（专业代码以105开头）须向医学院提交执业医师资格证书和住院医师规范化培训合格证书。
applicationMaterials.ru: Заявители на профессиональную докторантуру медицинского факультета (коды специальностей начинаются с 105) обязаны представить медицинскому факультету свидетельство о квалификации практикующего врача и свидетельство об окончании стандартизированной подготовки в ординатуре.
applicationMaterials.de: Bewerber für berufsorientierte Promotionsprogramme der medizinischen Fakultät (Studiengangscodes beginnend mit 105) müssen der medizinischen Fakultät einen Nachweis der ärztlichen Berufsqualifikation und einen Nachweis über den Abschluss der standardisierten ärztlichen Weiterbildung vorlegen.
applicationMaterials.es: Los solicitantes de doctorados profesionales de la Facultad de Medicina (códigos de programa que comienzan por 105) deben presentar a dicha facultad un certificado de cualificación de médico y un certificado de finalización de la formación estandarizada de residencia médica.
applicationMaterials.fr: Les candidats aux doctorats professionnels de la faculté de médecine (codes de programme commençant par 105) doivent remettre à cette faculté un certificat de qualification de médecin praticien et un certificat de fin de formation standardisée en résidence médicale.

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-medium: HSK level4 with210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-medium: HSK level 4 with 210 points or above; a university certificate showing Chinese as the prior-degree teaching medium may replace HSK.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课：HSK4级210分及以上；前置学历中文授课者可提供学校授课语言证明代替HSK。

eligibility.en: Applicants should generally be no older than 50 by September 1, 2027, in good physical and mental health, and non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign regular passport.
eligibility.zh: 截至2027年9月1日前，年龄一般不超过50周岁；身心健康、持外国有效普通护照的非中国籍公民。

eligibility.en: Graduating master’s students or applicants with a master’s degree or above.
eligibility.zh: 应届硕士毕业生或具有硕士以上学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants of Chinese origin must submit nationality pre-screening information/documents required by the application system and bring the papers at enrollment; failure of pre-screening or nationality determination cancels application, admission or student-status eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 外籍华人等按申请系统要求填写信息并上传国籍预审材料，入学带纸件；未通过预审或入学后国籍认定者失去申请、入学或学籍资格。

eligibility.en: Scholarship applicants must additionally satisfy the scholarship’s age and other criteria; this cycle lists the self-funded application deadline.
eligibility.zh: 奖学金申请者另须符合该奖学金的年龄和其他要求；本周期列出的截止时间为自费申请。

eligibility.en: Schools may arrange remote written examinations or interviews and assess subject background, language, research ability and application materials; admission is based on review and programme preferences.
eligibility.zh: 院系可能安排远程笔试或面试，并综合审核专业基础、语言、研究能力和申请材料；按审核及专业志愿择优录取。

applicationMaterials.en: Scan of the first page of a regular passport, valid beyond October 31, 2027.
applicationMaterials.zh: 普通护照首页扫描件，护照有效期至2027年10月31日后。

applicationMaterials.en: Birth certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 出生证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Parents’ valid identity documents.
applicationMaterials.zh: 父母有效身份证件。

applicationMaterials.en: Bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates or above and complete academic transcripts for both stages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 本科和硕士阶段及以上学历学位证书和完整成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Graduating students may initially submit an expected-graduation certificate and current transcripts.
applicationMaterials.zh: 应届毕业生可先提供预毕业证明和在校期间成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland must be notarized; present original degree certificates and notarization documents at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 国（境）外学历学位证书须经公证；报到须提供学历学位证书原件及相关公证文件。

applicationMaterials.en: Language proficiency evidence; the prior-degree medium-of-instruction alternative and official-English-language-country exemption apply as stated in the guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 语言水平证明，适用的前置学历授课语言证明或英语国家豁免须按官方指南办理。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, written in Chinese or English, stating name, employer, position and contact details, with the recommender’s signature or institutional stamp.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封副教授及以上专家推荐信，用中文或英文书写，含姓名、单位、职务、联系方式，并由推荐人签名或加盖单位公章。

applicationMaterials.en: A study/research plan of at least 1000 Chinese characters covering self-introduction, learning experience, study goals, research plan and career plans, written in Chinese.
applicationMaterials.zh: 不少于1000字的学习研究计划，含自我介绍、学习经历、学习目标、研究计划和职业规划；须用中文书写。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants to the School of Economics or Wang Yanan Institute must use the dedicated research-plan template.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经济学院和王亚南经济研究院申请者须使用研究计划专用模板。

applicationMaterials.en: Curriculum vitae.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人简历。

applicationMaterials.en: A pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the school is optional; holders receive admission priority.
applicationMaterials.zh: 导师签字、学院盖章的接收意向函为可选；取得者优先录取。
